image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small mustelid (likely a ferret or weasel) peering out from under a dark, textured overhang (possibly wood or stone). The animal has a cream/white face with dark markings around the eyes and nose, and a darker brown/black body. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the face while the body recedes into shadow. The foreground is blurred, creating a shallow depth of field.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, dark, and bead-like, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible on the sides of the head, appearing short and rounded, not pointed or elongated.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short dense fur in brown dorsally with white or yellow ventral coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears dense and soft. The coloration matches the description: lighter (cream/white) on the face/underside areas and darker (brown/black) on the dorsal side.

The legs are completely occluded by the animal's body position and the foreground/background elements. They cannot be visually verified.
